newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares firm on Dadas merger plans.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares firm on Dadas merger plans.

text.p: Slovenian shares rose 1.19 percent on Monday after financial consultancy Dadas announced a possible merger with financial consultancy Primofin.
"Dadas is probably trying to increase its capital and cut its operational costs with this move," Davor Dubokovic, a trader at brokerage Eastbrokers, said.
Noone at Dadas and Primofin was available for comment.
* The SBI index rose 14.18 points to 1,206.5.
* Primofin was the biggest gainer, surging 74.64 percent to 44,900 tolars.
* Dadas was the leading decliner, falling 33.30 percent to 15,660 tolars. -- Novica Mihajlovic, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
